minutes_text:
City of Inglewood
  Finance Department
  (310) 412-5257

  MINUTES
  CLAIMS REVIEW COMMITTEE
  January 28, 2019

A meeting of the Claims Review Committee was held in the Small Executive Conference
Room, 9th floor at 11:36 a.m.

  Members Present: Kenneth R. Campos, City Attorney
  Aisha Thompson, Deputy City Clerk
  Debbie Crenshaw, Deputy City Treasurer
  Maria E. Heaney, Finance Manager

  Staff Present:  Sabrina Barnes, Director of Parks, Recreation & Library Services
  Micah Herd, Police Grants Coordinator
  Cliff Pate, Fleet Services

1. The minutes of January 28, 2019, meeting was approved as recorded.
2. L.A. Business Printing – A motion was moved and seconded to approve the recommended
  settlement payment of $7,366.51. Motion carried unanimously.

3. It’s Your Party – A motion was moved and seconded to approve the recommended
  settlement payment of $6,150; City departments are required to obtain City Council review
  and authorization for payment of all future vendor invoices for It’s Your Party. Motion
  carried unanimously.

4. Huntington Beach Honda – A motion was moved and seconded to approve the
  recommend settlement payment of $6,566.00. Motion carried unanimously.

5. There being no further business, the meeting adjourned at 12:12 p.m.

Adjournment
